task_title: Unify sprite brief authoring context and reference previews
rescore_reason: The implementation is tooling-only: a thin canvas adapter over existing sidecar lifecycle contracts, which is capped at 3 apples by AGENTS.md.

plan_review.notes: Reviewed canonical sidecar adapter plan; retained the shared 13-stage queue and rejected direct DOM port, parallel endpoints, and canvas-local state.
plan_review.summary: Adopted the full canonical 13-stage QueueState and item-preserving ETag merge writes; canvas proxies only authoring routes and never worker or issue consumer routes; rewind remains pointer-only; generating polling is bounded.

code_review.notes: The final category/reference review fixed custom-category overwrite, blank-name reference selection, stale synthesized candidates after prompt edits, preview/generation name normalization drift, composer state loss across rerenders, and contradictory Azure enemy-facing guidance. Live validation then found and fixed an iframe helper scoping bug and new-request category draft loss.

independent_grade.notes: The change coherently unifies sprite category design-language injection across build-prompt.ts, judge.ts, and azure-chat-synth.ts via a single new sprite-category-design-language.ts source of truth, and adds a reference-preview capability wired through the sidecar server, sidecar-client, extension route, and renderer. Correctness is strong: the new /api/workflow/reference-preview endpoint validates name+concrete type (rejecting 'auto'), normalizes the name, reuses the deterministic seed-based selectReferences, and fails safe on unreadable/invalid PNGs; path safety is enforced twice (isSafeGeneratedAssetPath filter plus resolveGeneratedAssetPath confinement), and the name is only used as a selector seed so there is no path-injection surface. The generate-one.ts dedup into resolve-reference-selection.ts and reference-annotations.ts removes real duplication without behavioral change (readFileSync still used, no dangling imports, typecheck passes). editRequestItem validates every durable field at the state boundary and correctly resets downstream state only when a prompt-affecting field actually changes. Making floor enemyPackId optional (with a clear thrown error when a family is requested on a pack-less floor) plus floor3/floor4 additions are defensively handled and tested. Coverage is excellent: new sidecar route happy/skip/reject paths, category injection + request-local override, enemy-pack-less source ids, editRequestItem edge cases (metadata-only, unchanged, auto-typed, icon, validation), and pure request-filter/request-template round-trips are all covered by tests that would fail without the change. All touched paths are tooling/scripts and .github extensions (within the 3-apple tooling cap), the new logic is deterministic (no Math.random/Date.now), and no layer boundaries or system-wiring rules apply. Scope is moderately broad (edit/filter/template authoring surface alongside the category+preview unification) but every piece serves the stated Briefs authoring-context unification, with no unrelated rewrites. No high-confidence blocker, major, or minor findings.
